subject: Post-call: Bluewater discovery -> trial scope & access next steps
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@bluewater.ai>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@bluewater.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap and proposed trial scope (next steps)

Hi Liam / Maria —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the proposed 30-day trial approach so we have alignment before we kick off: 

Pain points we heard
- High variance in inference cost across batch vs real-time requests; current infra struggles during peak siting analysis (latency spikes).
- Need deterministic latency for client demos (p95 under 300ms) and predictable unit cost for budgeting.
- Security: must support customer-managed keys + audit logs for compliance.

Goals for the 30-day trial
- Surface baseline cost/latency with your sample workload and a Redwood-optimized model profile.
- Validate prompt/eval set and measure quality buckets (precision on extraction tasks, hallucination rate) against your ground truth.
- Demonstrate private deployment option with KMS integration for one environment.

Proposed trial scope (what Redwood will deliver)
- Environment: Dedicated trial cluster (single-tenant) in us-west with model variants preloaded.
- Metrics: token cost per 1k+ tokens, p50/p95 latency, per-prompt accuracy (as defined in prompt set).
- Success gates: p95 latency < 350ms on 95% of production-like traffic; semantic extraction F1 >= 0.88 on provided eval set.
- Owners: Rachel (program lead), Ben (solutions engineer, infra + access), Monica (customer success, adoption).
- Timeline: Kickoff week of Nov 22 -> env ready by Nov 24 -> prompt sets uploaded Nov 26 -> 30-day run Dec 1–Dec 30 -> final readout first week Jan.

Access steps required from Bluewater
1) Provide a short sample corpus (5k–10k tokens) and 200 labeled examples for the extraction eval.
2) Add ben.carter@redwood.ai and provision a service account with read-only access to the S3 bucket or share a presigned staging path.
3) Confirm KMS vendor and provide test key ARN for integration.

Attachments: redwood_poc-charter-v0.2.pdf (trial charter & SOW draft), access_matrix_template.csv (access fields we need).

Next steps (action items)
- Liam: confirm that the KMS ARN can be shared for a test key and any timeline constraints by EOD Tuesday (Nov 17).
- Maria: share sample corpus + labeled examples by Nov 19.
- Ben / Rachel: we'll send the deployment checklist and invite for kickoff sync once access is confirmed.

If that summary looks right, we can lock the kickoff for Nov 23 or 24 — whichever works for your engineering team.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
phone: +1 (415) 555-0189

--
Redwood Inference | Making inference predictable and economical
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@bluewater.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@bluewater.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:11:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and proposed trial scope (next steps)

Thanks Rachel — this is helpful and captures our discussion. A few follow-ups from our side: 

- KMS: we can provide a test key ARN, but procurement requires a signed SOW before we share it with third parties. Is the attached draft (redwood_poc-charter-v0.2.pdf) sufficient to get procurement moving?
- Latency gate: our internal target is p95 < 300ms, but we can accept 350ms for the trial if we see a clear path from the first two weeks of tuning. Will Redwood provide suggested quantization/config profiles to hit p95 goals?
- Data share: we'll provide the sample corpus but need to scrub PII before sharing. Expect the labeled examples by Nov 19 as requested.

Would prefer kickoff on Nov 24 (our engineers have an all-hands on Nov 23). If you can send the deployment checklist and S3 service-account steps, Ben can work with our infra folks Monday.

Liam
Liam O'Neal
Head of ML Platform, Bluewater AI
liam.oneal@bluewater.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@bluewater.ai>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@bluewater.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T14:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and proposed trial scope (next steps) — infra/access checklist

Hi Liam / Maria —

Appreciate the quick reply. Short answers to your items and a technical checklist below. The SOW draft is fine for procurement to start — we'll follow up with a one-page amendment if needed for KMS specifics.

Quantization & perf: We'll provide two recommended profiles (latency-optimized and cost-optimized). For the first 7–10 days we'll run latency-optimized config and collect traces to tune batch sizes / kernel selections. Expect a >15% p95 improvement after trace-driven tuning in many workloads.

Deployment checklist (what we need from Bluewater infra)
- IAM/service account OR presigned S3 path: grant read-only to staging bucket OR share presigned URLs for the dataset. Fields required in access_matrix_template.csv: bucket_name, prefix, principal_email, presigned_ttl.
- KMS: test key ARN + owner contact. We'll use this only for encryption at rest on the trial cluster.
- Network: allow outbound to 52.23.11.0/24 and 34.201.90.0/24 (Redwood egress IPs) for the trial cluster; if you prefer VPC peering, let us know the account ID.
- SSH: no SSH required for trial cluster; we provide access through the Redwood Console and temporary support sessions if needed.

I'll attach a lightweight runbook and the access_matrix_template.csv in the Google Drive link Rachel shared. Once you confirm the KMS procurement path, I can loop in our security engineer for a short call.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@bluewater.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T10:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and proposed trial scope (next steps)

Rachel / Ben — confirmed. Procurement can start with the SOW draft; I'll circle back if they need additional terms. We will: 

- Share scrubbed sample corpus (expected Nov 19) and the labeled extraction set.
- Provide a test KMS ARN to you under a mutual NDA path; procurement confirmed the timeline.
- Grant the read-only access via presigned S3 path (I will send details to ben.carter@redwood.ai by EOD Monday Nov 22).

We prefer kickoff on Nov 24 at 10:00 PT — please send a calendar invite and the kickoff agenda. Looking forward to the trial.

Thanks,
María Gomez
VP, Engineering Operations, Bluewater AI
maría.gomez@bluewater.ai
